description: This file defines an experimental staging module for PyTorch Distributed Checkpointing, including classes and functions for asynchronous and optimized checkpoint staging, resource management, and configuration options.

classes.name: CheckpointStager
classes.description: Abstract base class for checkpoint staging implementations, defining the interface for staging and cleanup.

classes.name: StagingOptions
classes.description: Configuration dataclass for checkpoint staging behavior, including options for pinned memory, shared memory, async staging, and non-blocking copy.

classes.name: DefaultStager
classes.description: Default implementation of CheckpointStager providing comprehensive staging features with support for async operations, resource cleanup, and performance optimizations.

methods.name: stage
methods.description: Initiates staging of a state dictionary, either synchronously or asynchronously based on configuration.

methods.name: _stage
methods.description: Performs the actual staging process, including copying tensors and synchronizing CUDA streams if needed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the stager, including shutting down thread pools and closing underlying storages.
